latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Vue Component Generator Free — rapid, code-free generation and download of Vue components via AI.

- Upload component descriptions as video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 200MB).
- Request reusable Vue components with natural language instructions.
- Automatic setup: obtains free token and connects to backend for new users.
- Export generated components as 1080p MP4 downloads.
- Built-in credit tracking, status, and error handling for a seamless experience.
